recipes.title: Whipped Milka Oreo ganache — 35% cream
recipes.summary: CuisineX pilot recipe: whipped ganache for verrines, no added sugar, using 200 g Milka Oreo and 300 g 35% UHT cream.
steps: Keep 200 g cream at 4–5 °C and reserve 50–100 g additional cream for correction if needed.
Melt 200 g Milka Oreo at 40–45 °C, target 42 °C.
Heat 100 g cream to 70 °C, acceptable range 65–75 °C.
Pour the hot cream over the chocolate in 2–3 additions and emulsify with a spatula.
Gradually add 200 g cold cream at 4–5 °C while the emulsion is still fluid.
Cover and mature in the refrigerator at least 6 h, ideally overnight, until 4–6 °C.
Whip at medium then moderate speed. Stop as soon as the ganache holds while remaining supple.
Pipe into glasses and add cold chocolate shards if desired.

techniques.title: Chocolate — melting, crystallization and tempering
techniques.summary: Cocoa butter is polymorphic: there is no single crystallization point. Tempering controls nucleation and crystalline structure.
techniques.warning: These are couverture reference curves. Filled/praline tablets such as Milka Oreo or Côte d’Or Praliné must not be treated as pure couverture.

techniques.title: Recover a ganache that is too firm before whipping
techniques.summary: Do not force the mixer. Warm the mass to 20–25 °C, add 20–30 g cream at 30–35 °C, then 10–20 g per correction if needed. Mature again to 4–6 °C.
